description: Get the latest MCP Check report for a server in the directory: its grade, spec version and every warning or failure with a fix.

server.description: The server URL, or its MCP Check directory id (from search_servers).

name: get_server

checkedAt.description: When the server was last checked (ISO 8601).

pageUrl.description: A link to see this on the MCP Check website.

partial.description: True when the server needs sign-in, so its tools were not graded.

problems.description: Warnings and failures, most serious first.

status.description: Whether the check failed or only warned.

specVersion.description: The MCP revision the server speaks, if it could be read.

url.description: The server URL that was checked.

title: Get a directory server's report
